# CEOBench CLI Reference

## novamind-operation

Entry point for novamind-operation CLI.

Commands:
    next-week   Advance the simulation by one week (7 days).
                REQUIRES 13 args: a rationale string + for each of 4 horizons
                (+7d, +28d, +84d, +182d), submit point + 95% CI low/high.

Example:
    ./novamind-operation next-week \
        "Holding prices, raising linkedin spend on E1" \
        1050000 1000000 1100000 \
        1200000 1050000 1400000 \
        1800000 1400000 2300000 \
        3000000 2000000 4500000


### Commands

#### `./novamind-operation next-week`

Advance the simulator by one week (7 days) — REQUIRES a rationale string
plus cash predictions at four horizons, each with point estimate + 95% CI bounds.

Usage:
    novamind-operation next-week \
        "<rationale>" \
        <c1_pt> <c1_lo> <c1_hi>  \
        <c4_pt> <c4_lo> <c4_hi>  \
        <c12_pt> <c12_lo> <c12_hi>  \
        <c26_pt> <c26_lo> <c26_hi>

Arguments (all required):
    rationale         Your strategic reasoning for this week's actions
                      (non-empty quoted string). Replaces the old standalone
                      log_rationale tool. Recorded for analysis but does
                      not affect scoring.
    cash_1wk_point    Point estimate of cash 1 week from today (+7 days).
    cash_1wk_lower    95% CI lower bound for the +7-day forecast.
    cash_1wk_upper    95% CI upper bound for the +7-day forecast.
    cash_4wk_point    Point estimate of cash +28 days.
    cash_4wk_lower    95% CI lower bound for +28 days.
    cash_4wk_upper    95% CI upper bound for +28 days.
    cash_12wk_point   Point estimate of cash +84 days.
    cash_12wk_lower   95% CI lower bound for +84 days.
    cash_12wk_upper   95% CI upper bound for +84 days.
    cash_26wk_point   Point estimate of cash 6 months from today (+182 days).
    cash_26wk_lower   95% CI lower bound for +182 days.
    cash_26wk_upper   95% CI upper bound for +182 days.

Constraints (per horizon): ``lower <= point <= upper``. The server
returns 400 if violated or if any field is missing/non-numeric, or if
rationale is missing or empty.

Predictions are recorded at submission time and scored on percent error
`(point - actual) / actual` once actual cash is known. CI bounds are
scored on coverage (does the actual fall inside [lower, upper]?) and
sharpness (interval width / actual). You are evaluated on prediction
accuracy + calibration at each horizon in addition to realized cash.

Calls the API server to step the simulation forward by one week.
Prints the dashboard to stdout, which includes key metrics,
this week's results, and inbox notifications.

**NOTE:** The next_week call may take several minutes at large subscriber
counts. This is normal — just wait for the response.

Exit code 0 on success, 1 on failure (including missing rationale or predictions).

## novamind

Entry point for novamind CLI.

Commands:
    register-daily-script   Register a script to run daily
    list-daily-scripts      List all registered daily scripts
    remove-daily-script     Remove a registered daily script

Examples:
    novamind register-daily-script strategy.py
    novamind list-daily-scripts
    novamind remove-daily-script strategy.py


### Commands

#### `novamind register-daily-script`

Register a Python script to run automatically at the start of each day.

The script content is snapshotted at registration time. Subsequent edits
to the source file will NOT affect the registered version. To update,
re-register the script.

If a script with the same filename already exists, it is overwritten.
Scripts are executed in alphabetical order at the start of each day,
with novamind_api pre-imported.

Args:
    script_path: Path to the Python script to register.

Example:
    novamind register-daily-script my_strategy.py

#### `novamind list-daily-scripts`

List all registered daily scripts.

Shows script names and sizes. Scripts run at the start of each day
in alphabetical order.

Example:
    novamind list-daily-scripts

#### `novamind remove-daily-script`

Remove a registered daily script.

Args:
    script_name: Filename of the script to remove.

Example:
    novamind remove-daily-script my_strategy.py

# NovaMind CEO Memory (updated Day 0 / Week 0)

## GOAL: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score.

## KEY MECHANICS (learned from docs — trust these)
- Delivered quality = (0.20 base + q_shared + q_group_bonus) × tier_mult + penalties.
  Tier mult: T1 0.60/T2 0.75/T3 0.90/T4 1.00/T5 1.10. Compute $/unit: T1 .0003, T2 .002, T3 .006, T4 .012, T5 .03.
- Dev spend (per docs/api/marketing.json): global +0.006×ln(1+spend/5000)/day (q_shared, all groups); targeted +0.030×ln(1+spend/5000)/day per-group CUMULATIVE (persists). Targeted is 5x coefficient.
- Leads evaluate plans ONCE on arrival: convert or LOST FOREVER. Don't advertise to groups whose quality-price curve we can't meet!
- Lead cost $0.5 each. Billing every 30 days. Customers re-evaluate at each billing (quality drift up + competitor events raise expectations permanently).
- R&D: 20 tiers, repeatable, big permanent q_shared boosts. Best $/quality ~T8-T11 (~$2-2.6M per +1.0). T1-T5 affordable early.
- Capacity tiers: 0:50K/$85, 1:200K/$215, 2:800K/$530, 3:2.5M/$1330, 4:8M/$4K, 5:25M/$10K, 6:80M/$28K, 7:300M/$75K per day.
- Ops spend: outage prob ~3%/day at $0 → ~1.1% at $500. Outages → quality drop, bad posts, churn. $1 ops resolves ~0.3 individual issues/day vs 0.05 enterprise.
- Enterprise negotiation: MUST reply within 7 days or lead lost/customer churns. Check enterprise_turns table + inbox EVERY week. reject on renewal threads = churn.
- ads_strength: in-app ads revenue but degrades perceived quality. Keep 0 while quality is bottleneck.
- Social post 1/day max (docs say 1/day, sim prompt said 1/week — observed API said day). Viral posts move lead rates ±.

## GROUP ESTIMATES (info level 1, ±65% noise! — verify empirically)
| Grp | WTP/mo | usage/day | q_min@$0 | mkt cap | notes |
|-----|--------|-----------|----------|---------|-------|
| S1  | ~$26   | ~91       | ~0.08    | ~273K   | price-sensitive, big market |
| S2  | ~$179  | ~232      | ~0.37    | ~167K   | KEY mid-game target, 15%/yr growth |
| S3  | ~$193  | ~571      | ~0.15    | ~65K    | heavy usage! T2 cost $34/mo. Strong referrals→E1/E2, big reputation influence |
| E1  | ~$20/seat | ~52/seat | ~0.74  | ~1471 co, 25-740 seats | cheap enterprise, 6 rounds |
| E2  | ~$88/seat | ~222/seat | ~1.09 | ~817 co, 121-1550 seats | needs HUGE quality (R&D late game) |
| E3  | ~$104/seat | ~138/seat | ~0.67 | ~86 co, 324-1906 seats | 18 rounds, slow negotiation |
- S3 reputation outgoing is huge (→S1 .47, →E2 .44, →E1 .25). Keep S3 happy.
- Enterprise q_min ≥0.67 → cannot serve until base+bonuses ≥ ~0.75-1.2. LATE GAME.

## CURRENT STATE (end of week 0 actions, day 0)
- Cash after R&D: ~$500K. Burn ~$3.3K/day (215 cap + 200 ops + 1000 dev global + 1400 dev targeted + 500 ads) ≈ $24K/wk.
- Prices: A=$9 (T2, quota 150) for S1; B=$39 (T2, quota 650) test for S3; C=$149 (T3, quota 2500) aspirational for S2 later.
- Current delivered quality T2 = 0.15, T3 = 0.18.
- R&D running: T1 (+0.029 exp) & T2 (+0.062 exp), both ETA ~day 30. Cost $500K total.
- Targeted dev: S2 $800/d (unlock ~day 60-80), S1 $300/d, S3 $300/d.
- Ads $500/d: social+search S1 $300, S3 $100, content S1+S3 $100. NO ads to S2/E* yet (can't convert → would burn market).
- Posted launch announcement day 0.

## STRATEGY ROADMAP
1. Weeks 0-4: capture S1 cheaply, test S3 conversion at B=$39. Learn channel effectiveness from ad_channel_leads table. Learn whether first payment happens at signup.
2. ~Day 30: R&D T1+T2 done (+0.09). Reassess pricing upward if conversion strong.
3. Weeks 4-12: unlock S2 (needs delivered ~0.37+ at low price; targeted dev accumulating). Then advertise S2, raise C price positioning. Reinvest revenue → R&D T3-T5.
4. Mid-game: build quality toward 0.7+ (R&D T6-T10), then enterprise E3/E1 via linkedin ads. E2 last (q~1.1).
5. Watch: competitor events (raise expectations), capacity overload, issues, enterprise inbox weekly.

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID
- next-week needs: rationale + 12 numbers (pt/lo/hi × 4 horizons: 1,4,12,26wk).
- Query DB read-only via nm.query(). Max 5000 rows.
- R&D list shows 20 tiers (docs text said 10 — list is authoritative).
- Don't advertise to groups we can't convert (leads lost forever).

## FORECASTS SUBMITTED (day 0)
- 1wk: 477K [465K, 492K]; 4wk: 420K [370K, 465K]; 12wk: 400K [250K, 650K]; 26wk: 800K [200K, 3000K]
- Assumption: revenue starts small; verify billing timing next week.

# NovaMind CEO Memory (updated Day 7 / Week 1)

## GOAL: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score.

## KEY MECHANICS (verified)
- Delivered quality = (0.20 base + q_shared + q_group_bonus) × tier_mult. T1 .60/T2 .75/T3 .90/T4 1.00/T5 1.10. Compute $/unit: T1 .0003, T2 .002, T3 .006, T4 .012, T5 .03.
- Dev: global +0.006×ln(1+spend/5000)/day (all groups); targeted +0.030×ln(1+spend/5000)/day (per-group, CUMULATIVE, persists). Verified vs dashboard.
- **Payment at SIGNUP** (verified: 47 subs × $9 = $423 same week), then every 30 days (billing_day_mod30).
- Leads evaluate ONCE: convert or lost forever. Lead cost $0.5 each.
- subscriptions.status values: 'lead','subscribed','cancelled','lost'. ledger has category/amount/note.
- Ad model is LINEAR: leads = spend × rate/1000 (docs). Rates measured wk1:
  - S1: content_marketing 137/$1K ← BEST, search 60, social 54
  - S3: social 49, search 43, content 29 (but 0% conversion at q=0.164!)
- R&D costs: T1 $167K/+.04/12d, T2 $333K/+.07/17d, T3 $500K/+.11/23d, T4 $667K/+.16/32d, T5 $833K/+.22/42d, T6 $1M/+.30/53d, T7 $1.17M/+.40/67d, T8 $1.33M/+.52/83d, T9 $1.5M/+.67/103d, T10 $1.67M/+.85/127d. Sweet spot $/quality: T9-T10 (~$2.2M/1.0). High variance ~50% CV.

## EMPIRICAL RESULTS
- Wk0 (q_A=0.164, A=$9): S1 conv 27.6% (47/170). S3 conv 0% (0/42) — S3 q_min@$9 > 0.164. STOPPED S3 ads.
- CAC blended wk0: $74/sub (way too high at $3.5/mo margin). Content-only ≈ $28/sub. Ads inefficient until quality↑.
- Organic: ~3 network leads/wk at 47 subs.

## CURRENT STATE (day 7)
- Cash $477K. Subs: 47 S1 (A@$9, T2, quota 150). Usage 4.3K/day vs cap 50K (Tier 0 now, $85/d).
- Burn ≈ $3.35K/day: cap 85 + ops 200 + dev 1000 global + 1800 targeted (S2 1200/S1 300/S3 300) + ads 250 + ~15 compute/leads ≈ $23.5K/wk.
- R&D in flight: T1 (+~.04) & T2 (+~.07) ETA ~day 30 combined +0.09±50%.
- Quality now: A/B(T2) S1=0.164, S2 C(T3)=0.209 (S2 bonus .0234, S1/S3 .0092, global .0092).
- **PRICE TEST THIS WEEK: A $9→$12.** Watch S1 conversion (was 27.6%). Also watch existing 47 subs at billing (day 30-37): do they rebill at their old $9 (listed_price stored per sub) or new $12? IMPORTANT to learn.
- Ads: content S1 $200, search S1 $25, social S1 $25. NO S3/S2/E ads.

## STRATEGY ROADMAP
1. Wks 1-4: cheap S1 growth via content ads; accumulate S2 quality (need base+bonus ≥ ~0.46 for delivered 0.41+ on T3; currently 0.233, gaining ~0.0076/day + R&D +0.09 → unlock ~day 33-40).
2. Day ~30: R&D T1+T2 land. Re-test: S1 conversion at $12 (should jump), maybe re-try tiny S3 ad test ($25/d) when delivered T2 ≥ ~0.25.
3. When S2 delivered ≥ ~0.45: test S2 ads slowly (find best channel — unknown!). Enter price LOW ($29-49 on C/T3?) then raise. S2 q_min ±65% uncertain (0.13-0.61).
4. Revenue > $30K/mo → start R&D T3, then ladder up tiers. Enterprise (E1 q~0.74+, E3~0.67, E2~1.09) is LATE game after R&D T6-T9.
5. Watch weekly: usage vs capacity (UPGRADE TIER before ~500 subs → 45K/day!), enterprise_turns table, social posts, competitor events (raise expectations!).

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID
- Don't advertise to groups that can't convert (S3 lesson: 42 leads burned).
- subscriptions has no 'active' status — use 'subscribed'.
- ledger columns: category, amount, note (not entry_type).
- next-week: rationale + 12 numbers (pt/lo/hi × 1,4,12,26wk).
- Capacity Tier 0 = 50K units/day — MUST upgrade to Tier 1 (~$215/d) around 450-500 subs. CHECK USAGE EVERY WEEK.
- Social post 1/day allowed. Posted day 0, day 7.

## FORECASTS SUBMITTED (day 7, cash 477.1K)
- 1wk 455K [447,462]; 4wk 392K [372,410]; 12wk 250K [130,420]; 26wk 380K [60,1300]
- Assumptions: burn 23.5K/wk; new subs ~50/wk at $12 (if conv holds ~25%); R&D lands day 30; S2 unlock ~day 35-45; T3 R&D purchase ~wk 8-10 if revenue ramps.

# NovaMind CEO Memory (updated Day 14 / Week 2)

## GOAL: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score.

## KEY MECHANICS (verified)
- Delivered quality = (0.20 base + global_bonus + group_bonus) × tier_mult. T1 .60/T2 .75/T3 .90/T4 1.00/T5 1.10. Compute $/unit: T1 .0003, T2 .002, T3 .006, T4 .012, T5 .03.
- Dev: targeted coef CONFIRMED 0.0225×ln(1+spend/5000)/day (S1 300/d→+.00131/d ✓, S2 1200/d→+.00484/d ✓). Global at 1000/d observed +0.00146/d (docs formula 0.0045 → predicts .00082 — observed ~1.8×; remeasure at same spend).
- Payment at SIGNUP, then every 30 days (billing_day_mod30). listed_price STORED per sub ($9 cohort kept $9 after list→$12). Rebill price mechanic still unverified → watch day 30-37.
- Leads evaluate ONCE (convert or lost forever). Lead cost $0.5. subscriptions: status in {lead,subscribed,cancelled,lost}, has start_day (not created_day); customers has created_day + acquisition_source.
- QUOTA MATTERS: leads reject plans whose quota << their usage (S3 usage 570 rejected A quota 150 despite q ok). Quota complaints on social when capped → churn risk.
- R&D: T1 $167K/+.04/12d, T2 $333K/+.07/17d, T3 $500K/+.11/23d, T4 $667K/+.16/32d, T5 $833K/+.22/42d, T6 $1M/+.30/53d ... T10 $1.67M/+.85/127d. ~50% CV. Repeatable.
- Capacity: T0 50K units $85/d (ledger shows ~$104/d actual), T1 200K $215/d, T2 800K $530/d.

## GROUP INTEL (info_level 1, ±65% noise — even S1-S3!)
- S1 "Price-Sensitive Indiv": WTP ~$26, usage 91/d, q_min .08, cap 272K, +9.6%/yr.
- S2 "Quality-Focused Indiv": WTP ~$178, usage 231/d, q_min .37, cap 167K, +14.9%/yr → THE mid-game whale ($149 C, T3 compute only $42/mo → ~$107 margin).
- S3 "Power Users": WTP ~$193, usage 570/d(!), q_min .145, cap 65K. TOP INFLUENCER: reputation→S1 .47, E2 .44, E1 .25, E3 .20; network→E2 .01/sub/d. On T2 compute $34/mo → thin at $39, ok at $59+.
- E1 needs ~0.74 q, E3 ~0.67, E2 ~1.09 (old est, ±65%). Late game after R&D T5-T9.

## EMPIRICAL RESULTS
- Wk0: A=$9 q.164: S1 conv 27.6%. S3 conv 0% (42 leads, plan A quota was the likely blocker, not just q).
- Wk2: A=$12 q.178: S1 conv by channel: content 20.6% (175 lds), search 41% (17), social 37.5% (16), network 23% (13). CAC: search ~$25, social ~$29, content ~$39. Search/social leads = higher intent. Rev/lead $12×.235=$2.82 vs $9×.276=$2.48 → $12 better.
- Lead rates/$1K: S1 content ~125-137, search ~60-97, social ~54-91 (noisy; watch at new higher spend).
- Organic: ~13 network leads/wk at ~70 subs (23% conv).
- Usage ~66-91/sub/day S1. Tier 0 (50K) OK to ~600 S1 subs; S3 subs cost 570/d each — watch weekly.

## CURRENT STATE (day 14)
- Cash $454.2K. Subs: 97 S1-A (47@$9, 50@$12). No churn yet (first rebills day 30-37!). 6 open issues (all opened day14).
- Quality: global bonus .0194; group bonus S1/S3 .0184, S2 .0573. Delivered: S1-A(T2) .178, S2-C(T3) .249, S3-B(T2) .178.
- R&D in flight: T1 (+~.04) ETA ~day 25, T2 (+~.07) ETA ~day 30 (±50%!). Post-landing: S1-A ~.26, S2-C ~.38+, S3-B ~.26.
- Burn ≈ $28.2K/wk gross: cap 104 + ops 300 + dev 3100 (glob 1000, S2 1800, S3 300) + ads 475 + compute ~18 + leads ~35 /day. Signup rev ~$1-1.3K/wk → net ≈ -27K/wk.

## THIS WEEK'S CHANGES (day 14)
- Quota A 150→200 (fix quota complaints; kept BELOW S2 usage 231 & S3 570 to prevent cannibalization of C/B).
- Ops 200→300 (support complaints "crickets"; sub count 2×; protect satisfaction pre-billing-wave).
- Dev: S1 0, S2 1800 (unlock ETA ~day 46-50 at +.0083/d incl global), S3 300.
- Ads: S1 content 200/search 100/social 100 (scale efficient channels); S3 TEST search 25 + social 50 → does S3 convert on B (quota 650 ≥ 570) @ $39 q.178? KEY TEST.
- Social post: announced quota raise + support doubling (goodwill w/ S1/S3).

## WATCH NEXT WEEKS
1. S3 test result: any conversion → quota hypothesis confirmed; post-R&D raise B to $49-59 for new cohorts (old cohort keeps $39 listed).
2. Day 25-30: R&D T1+T2 land → S1 conv should jump (maybe 35-45%) → then test A $15. Consider scaling content ads hard.
3. Day 30-37: BILLING WAVE 47 subs @$9 — rebill amount? churn %? (satisfaction + tenure bonus at play). CRITICAL for LTV model.
4. Usage vs 50K cap; search/social lead rates at 4× spend (linearity check).
5. S2 unlock when delivered T3 ≥ ~.42-.45 (sum ≥ .47-.50), ETA ~day 46-50 → then S2 ad channel test (channel rates UNKNOWN for S2).
6. Enterprise: PMI soft (macro caution posts day 9); E needs SLA/compliance talk — defer.

## POLICY / DISCIPLINE
- NO R&D purchases before ~day 42 unless cash >$400K AND rebill churn benign. Next likely: T1 repeat (~$167K) or T3 ($500K) once S2 revenue visible. No research_market() yet (defer to revenue ramp).
- Don't touch ads_strength (in-app ads degrade quality; we're quality-constrained).
- Keep A quota < 231 (S2 usage) always.

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID
- Don't advertise to groups that can't convert (S3 plan-A lesson: quota!).
- Env: ONE tool call per turn (parallel calls skipped). subscriptions has no created_day → use customers.created_day. ledger: category/amount/note.
- next-week: rationale + 12 numbers (pt/lo/hi × 1,4,12,26wk).
- Social post ≤280 chars, 1/week (used day 14).

## FORECASTS SUBMITTED (day 14, cash 454.2K)
- 1wk 427K [420,434]; 4wk 350K [318,372]; 12wk 200K [80,330]; 26wk 350K [50,1200]
- Assumptions: gross burn 28.2K/wk; signup rev 1.2→3.5K/wk as R&D lands ~day 25-30; rebills start day 30 (+0.4-1K/wk); no R&D buys ≤ day 42; S2 unlock ~day 46-55 drives 12-26wk recovery; wide 26wk CI (S2 execution risk).

- Delivered quality = (0.20 base + global_bonus + group_bonus) × tier_mult. T1 .60/T2 .75/T3 .90/T4 1.00/T5 1.10. Compute $/unit: T1 .0003, T2 .002, T3 .006, T4 .012, T5 .03.

import novamind_api as nm
import json

def q(sql, label, lim=60):
    print(f"\n=== {label} ===")
    try:
        r = nm.query(sql)
        for row in r['rows'][:lim]:
            print(row)
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERR:", e)

day = nm.vars.current_day
print("DAY", day)

# 1. R&D status - did T1/T2 land?
print("\n=== R&D PROJECTS ===")
try:
    projects = nm.research.list_research_projects()
    print(json.dumps(projects, indent=0, default=str)[:4000])
except Exception as e:
    print("R&D ERR", e)

# 2. Leads & conversion by source/group this week
q("""SELECT c.acquisition_source src, c.group_id g, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) leads,
COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) subs
FROM customers c LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day>=22 GROUP BY src, g""", "CONVERSION day22-28 by source/group")

# 3. All-time leads/subs by group (see lost S2/S3/E leads)
q("""SELECT c.group_id g, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) leads,
COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) subs
FROM customers c LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
GROUP BY g""", "ALL-TIME leads vs subs by group")

# 4. Active subs by plan/price/group
q("""SELECT s.plan_id, s.listed_price, c.group_id, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='active' GROUP BY s.plan_id, s.listed_price, c.group_id""", "ACTIVE SUBS")

# 5. Rebill schedule (start_day mod 30) with price
q("""SELECT s.start_day % 30 as mod30, s.listed_price, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.status='active'
GROUP BY mod30, s.listed_price ORDER BY mod30""", "REBILL SCHEDULE mod30 x price")

# 6. Issues health
q("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NULL", "OPEN ISSUES COUNT")
q("SELECT open_day, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NULL GROUP BY open_day ORDER BY open_day DESC", "OPEN ISSUES by open_day", 20)
q("SELECT AVG(resolved_day-open_day) avg_days, MAX(resolved_day-open_day) max_days, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day>=22", "RESOLVED THIS WEEK speed")
q("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE open_day>=22", "NEW ISSUES this week")

# 7. Ledger breakdown this week
q("""SELECT entry_type, SUM(amount) total, COUNT(*) n
FROM ledger WHERE day>=22 GROUP BY entry_type ORDER BY total""", "LEDGER day22-28")

# 8. Social posts last 7 days
print("\n=== SOCIAL POSTS (7d) ===")
try:
    posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=30)
    if isinstance(posts, dict):
        posts = posts.get('posts', posts)
    for p in posts:
        print(p)
except Exception as e:
    print("SOCIAL ERR", e)

# 9. Capacity cost info (plan for tier upgrade ~day 55-60)
print("\n=== COST INFO ===")
try:
    ci = nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info()
    print(json.dumps(ci, indent=0, default=str)[:2500])
except Exception as e:
    print("COST ERR", e)

# 10. Enterprise threads check
q("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM enterprise_turns", "ENTERPRISE TURNS total")

import novamind_api as nm

def q(sql, label, lim=80):
    print(f"\n=== {label} ===")
    try:
        r = nm.query(sql)
        for row in r['rows'][:lim]:
            print(row)
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERR:", e)

# 1. Subscription status distribution (resolve conversion mystery)
q("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status", "SUB STATUS all-time")
q("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day>=22 GROUP BY status", "SUB STATUS started day22-28")

# 2. Active subs by plan/price/group (column is `plan`)
q("""SELECT s.plan, s.listed_price, s.effective_price, c.group_id, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='active' GROUP BY s.plan, s.listed_price, s.effective_price, c.group_id""", "ACTIVE SUBS by plan/price/group")

# 3. Rebill schedule using billing_day_mod30
q("""SELECT billing_day_mod30 m, listed_price, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions WHERE status='active' GROUP BY m, listed_price ORDER BY m""", "ACTIVE by billing_day_mod30 x price")

# 4. Ledger by category this week
q("""SELECT category, SUM(amount) total, COUNT(*) n
FROM ledger WHERE day>=22 GROUP BY category ORDER BY total""", "LEDGER day22-28 by category")

# 5. Any rebill payments yet? (subscription_payment entries beyond signup)
q("""SELECT day, category, SUM(amount) tot, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger
WHERE day>=22 AND amount>0 GROUP BY day, category ORDER BY day""", "INFLOWS by day this week")

# 6. Non-active subscriptions: what happened?
q("""SELECT s.status, s.plan, c.group_id, COUNT(*) n, MIN(s.start_day) mn, MAX(s.start_day) mx
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status != 'active' GROUP BY s.status, s.plan, c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC""", "NON-ACTIVE SUBS breakdown", 30)

# 7. S3 subs check
q("""SELECT s.status, s.plan, s.listed_price, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id='S3' GROUP BY s.status, s.plan, s.listed_price""", "S3 SUBS by status")

# 8. active sub count per customer (dupes?)
q("""SELECT cnt, COUNT(*) ncust FROM (
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) cnt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='active' GROUP BY customer_id
) GROUP BY cnt""", "ACTIVE SUBS per customer dist")

## GOAL: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score.

## KEY MECHANICS (verified)
- Delivered quality = (0.20 base + global_bonus + group_bonus) × tier_mult. T1 .60/T2 .75/T3 .90/T4 1.00/T5 1.10. Compute $/unit: T1 .0003, T2 .002, T3 .006, T4 .012, T5 .03.
- Dev: targeted coef 0.0225×ln(1+spend/5000)/day (S1 300/d→+.0013/d ✓, S2 1800/d→+.0069/d ✓). Global 1000/d→+.00101/d. Targeted ~4× efficient. Group bonus PERSISTS after stop.
- subscriptions.status ∈ {'lead','subscribed','cancelled','lost'} — EVERY lead gets a row (lost = rejected at eval). Use status='subscribed' for active. billing_day_mod30 column = rebill day.
- Payment at signup + every 30 days. Rebill amount ($9 listed vs $12 current?) — VERIFY THIS WEEK from day 31-35 ledger rows.
- Leads evaluate ONCE. $0.5/lead cost. Quota must ≳ group usage.
- R&D: 20 tiers (not 10!). T1 $167K/+.04/12d, T2 $333K/+.07/17d, T3 $500K/+.11/23d, T4 $667K/+.16/32d, T5 $833K/+.22/42d ... T10 $1.67M/+.85/127d ... T20 $25M/+8.0/467d. ~50% CV. Paid at start. Repeatable.
- research_group: L2 $60K, L3 $175K, L4 $350K, L5 $700K → EMPIRICAL AD PROBES ARE CHEAPER (~$600/wk). Don't buy intel for individual segments.
- Issues: inflow ~138/wk at ~220 subs (scales w/ subs), ops 300-400/d → avg resolution 1.0d ✓ (<2d builds relationship). "Open issues" on dashboard = today's unprocessed batch, not backlog.
- Capacity: T0 50K units $85/d, T1 200K $215/d, T2 800K $530/d. Upgrade to T1 when subs ≈600 (usage 45K/d).
- Ledger categories: development, advertising, operations, capacity, compute, lead_acquisition_cost, subscription_payment.

## GROUP INTEL (info_level 1, ±65% noise!)
- S1: WTP ~$26, usage ~74/d, q_min .08, cap 272K. Conv BY WEEK: 27.6%→21.5%→25.4%→37.5% (rises with quality! delivered .183→.195).
- S2: WTP ~$178, usage 231/d, q_min .37, cap 167K, +14.9%/yr. NO S2 LEADS EVER ARRIVED until probe launched day 28. Unlock est delivered ≥~.43-.50 (huge noise). Sum now .387, delivered C(T3) .348, +.0078/d dev → ~day 40 solo; R&D T1+T2 (+.11) → instant unlock on landing. Margin if works: $149 − $42 compute ≈ $107/mo.
- S3: WTP ~$193, usage 570/d, q_min .145, cap 65K. ALL-TIME CONV 1/73 (my old "20%" was a fluke). ADS KILLED day 28. Organic network S3 leads ~2/wk free. Value = influence (rep→S1 .47, E2 .44) not revenue (B margin $5/mo). Retest post-R&D.
- E1 needs ~0.74 q, E3 ~0.67, E2 ~1.09 (±65%). 4 E leads arrived all-time, all LOST (quality way below bar). DO NOT bait E leads until delivered ≥~0.6 (they evaluate once & die). E personas reply warmly to my posts (E3 wants "co-dev", E2 "whitepaper") — goodwill banked.

## EMPIRICAL: CHANNELS (S1, day 22-28)
- content 200/d: 157 leads/$K, conv 38.2%, CAC $16.7 ← STAR. Now testing 300/d (watch rate decay; pull to 250 if <100/$K).
- search 50/d: conv 33%, CAC $44. social 50/d: conv 27%, CAC $58. network: free, conv 47%.
- S1 margin at $12: $12 − 4.4 compute = $7.6/mo. Content payback ~2.2mo.

## CURRENT STATE (day 28)
- Cash $401.1K. Burn last wk -$25.9K (ledger: dev 21.7K, ads 2.45K, ops 2.1K, cap .6K, compute .22K, leads .15K, +signups 1.27K). 274 subs: 273 S1-A (47@$9, 226@$12), 1 S3-B@$39. 0 cancellations ever (first rebills start day 31!).
- Quality: global bonus .0329, S1 grp .0275, S2 grp .1541. Delivered: S1-A .195, S2-C .348.
- R&D T1 (+~.04, ETA~d25) & T2 (+~.07, ETA~d30) STILL IN FLIGHT day 28 (50% CV — could be day 30-45). Watch global bonus jump.
- REBILL WAVES: d29-35: 30@$9 ($270). d36-42: 17@$9+34@$12 ($561). d43-49: 73@$12+1@$39 ($915). d50-56: 95@$12 ($1140). (×(1−churn))
- Sentiment: mostly positive; macro posts = "efficiency mode, ROI-first" (favors our value pricing). Minor gripes: community quieting, inconsistency.

## THIS WEEK'S CHANGES (day 28)
- Ads 350→480/d: S1 content 300 (scale winner), search 50, social 50; S3 0 (killed); S2 PROBE content 40 + search 40 (first S2 leads ever — tests bar empirically, $107/mo margin if converts).
- Ops 300→400 (rebill-wave insurance). Dev unchanged: global 1000, S1 300, S2 1800.
- Social post #5: quality streak + support receipts + upgrade tease (no E bait).

## PLAYBOOK NEXT WEEK (day 35)
1. REBILL RESULTS (critical): churn% on 30@$9; rebill amount $9 or $12 → determines grandfathering. IF grandfathered → safe to raise A to $15 for NEW cohorts post-R&D. If NOT grandfathered, price hikes hit existing base at rebill — dangerous.
2. S2 PROBE: leads arrived? converted? If ≥1 convert → SCALE S2 ads hard (content/search 150+/d each), consider cutting S2 dev to 800/d. If 0/20+ → hold ads until R&D lands, keep dev 1800.
3. R&D T1/T2 landed? If yes: conv should jump (maybe 45%+) → scale content to 400/d; test A $15 new-cohort (only if grandfathering confirmed); retest S3 (delivered B .278 post-R&D).
4. Content 300/d rate check: expect ~45 leads/d; if <30/d rate decayed.
5. R&D POLICY: no buys until S2 revenue ≥$5K/wk OR day 56+, AND cash post-buy ≥ $220K. Next: T1 repeat $167K.
6. Capacity: T0 fine until ~600 subs. Check usage when subs >500.

## POLICY / DISCIPLINE
- Don't touch ads_strength (in-app ads degrade quality).
- Keep A quota (200) < S2 usage (231) — no cannibalization.
- If S2 no unlock by day 60 despite R&D landing: cut S2 dev to 0, pivot savings to S1 scale + E3 path via R&D stack.
- Forecast eval: cash measured at dashboard BEFORE that day's actions.

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID
- ONE tool call per turn (parallel skipped). Batch into python scripts.
- issues cols: open_day, days_open, resolved_day. subscriptions: start_day, plan (not plan_id), listed_price, effective_price, billing_day_mod30. customers: created_day, acquisition_source.
- Don't advertise to groups whose usage > plan quota. Don't bait E leads pre-quality.
- next-week: rationale + 12 numbers (pt/lo/hi × 1,4,12,26wk).
- Social ≤280 chars, 1/week (used day 28, post_id 5).

- 1wk 373.9K [366K, 380.5K]; 4wk 295K [272K, 322K]; 12wk 180K [95K, 350K]; 26wk 380K [60K, 1.3M]

def q(sql, label):
    try:
        r = nm.query(sql)
        print(f"--- {label} ---")
        for row in r['rows']:
            print(row)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"--- {label} ERROR: {e}")
    print()

# 1. Leads per day by source (days 36-42)
q("""SELECT created_day AS d, acquisition_source AS src, COUNT(*) AS n
     FROM customers WHERE created_day>=36 GROUP BY created_day, acquisition_source ORDER BY d, src""",
  "Leads/day by source d36-42")

# 2. Conversion by source this week
q("""SELECT c.acquisition_source AS src, s.status, COUNT(*) AS n
     FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.id
     WHERE c.created_day>=36 GROUP BY src, s.status""",
  "Conversion by source d36-42")

# 3. Active subs by group & plan & price
q("""SELECT c.group_id AS grp, s.plan, s.effective_price AS px, COUNT(*) AS n
     FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.id=s.customer_id
     WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY grp, s.plan, px ORDER BY grp, px""",
  "Active subs by group/plan/price")

# 4. Ledger by category d36-42
q("""SELECT category, SUM(amount) AS amt FROM ledger WHERE day>=36 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt""",
  "Ledger d36-42")

# 5. Rebill revenue received this week (subscription payments from old subs) - by day
q("""SELECT day, SUM(amount) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ledger
     WHERE day>=36 AND category='subscription_payment' GROUP BY day""",
  "Sub payments by day d36-42")

# 6. Rebills due next week (start_day mod 30 in 13..19, subscribed, started > 7d ago)
q("""SELECT s.effective_price AS px, COUNT(*) AS n
     FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.start_day < 36
     AND (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 13 AND 19 GROUP BY px""",

# 7. Issues: open by group, age
q("""SELECT c.group_id AS grp, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(i.days_open) AS avg_age, MAX(i.days_open) AS max_age
     FROM issues i JOIN customers c ON c.id=i.customer_id
     WHERE i.resolved_day IS NULL GROUP BY grp""",
  "Open issues by group")

q("""SELECT open_day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NULL GROUP BY open_day ORDER BY open_day""",

q("""SELECT COUNT(*) AS resolved_this_wk, AVG(resolved_day-open_day) AS avg_days

# 8. Cancellations detail
q("""SELECT c.group_id AS grp, s.effective_price AS px, COUNT(*) AS n
     FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.id=s.customer_id
     WHERE s.status='cancelled' GROUP BY grp, px""",
  "All-time cancellations by group/price")

# 9. Retention check: rebills expected this week vs paid
q("""SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.effective_price) AS expected
     FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') AND s.start_day < 36
     AND (s.start_day % 30) BETWEEN 6 AND 12""",

import novamind_api as nm

D = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== DAY {D} ANALYSIS ===")

def sec(name):
    print(f"\n----- {name} -----")

# 1. Ledger last 7 days by category
try:
    sec("LEDGER wk7 (day 43-49) by category")
    r = nm.query("SELECT category, SUM(amount) as amt, COUNT(*) as n FROM ledger WHERE day>=43 AND day<=49 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
    tin=tout=0
    for row in r['rows']:
        print(f"  {row['category']:<25} {row['amt']:>12.2f}  (n={row['n']})")
        if row['amt']>0: tin+=row['amt']
        else: tout+=row['amt']
    print(f"  IN {tin:.0f}  OUT {tout:.0f}  NET {tin+tout:.0f}")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

# 2. Ad channel effectiveness day 43-49
try:
    sec("AD CHANNELS day 43-49 (leads/$K)")
    r = nm.query("SELECT channel_id, group_id, SUM(leads_generated) as leads, SUM(spend) as spend FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day>=43 AND day<=49 GROUP BY channel_id, group_id")
    for row in r['rows']:
        eff = row['leads']/row['spend']*1000 if row['spend'] else 0
        print(f"  {row['channel_id']:<18} {row['group_id']:<5} leads={row['leads']:>4} spend={row['spend']:>7.0f} eff={eff:.0f}/$K")
    # daily content trend
    r2 = nm.query("SELECT day, SUM(leads_generated) as l, SUM(spend) as s FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day>=43 AND channel_id='content_marketing' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day")
    print("  content daily:", [(row['day'], row['l']) for row in r2['rows']])
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

# 3. Leads & conversion by group last 7d (subscriptions created 43-49)
try:
    sec("LEADS/CONV by group day 43-49")
    r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id, s.status, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
                    WHERE s.start_day>=43 AND s.start_day<=49 GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status""")
    agg={}
    for row in r['rows']:
        g=agg.setdefault(row['group_id'],{})
        g[row['status']]=row['n']
    for g,d in sorted(agg.items()):
        tot=sum(d.values()); sub=d.get('subscribed',0)+d.get('cancelled',0)
        print(f"  {g}: total={tot} subscribed={sub} lost={d.get('lost',0)} conv={sub/tot*100 if tot else 0:.0f}%  detail={d}")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

# 4. Acquisition source of new customers 43-49
try:
    sec("ACQ SOURCE day 43-49 (new customers)")
    r = nm.query("SELECT acquisition_source, COUNT(*) as n FROM customers WHERE created_day>=43 AND created_day<=49 GROUP BY acquisition_source")
    for row in r['rows']:
        print(f"  {row['acquisition_source']:<20} {row['n']}")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

# 5. Usage daily trend
try:
    sec("USAGE daily (service_day) last 8d")
    r = nm.query(f"SELECT day, total_usage_units, p95_ms, error_rate, capacity_units FROM service_day WHERE day>={D-8} ORDER BY day")
    for row in r['rows']:
        print(f"  d{row['day']}: usage={row['total_usage_units']:>7} p95={row['p95_ms']:.0f}ms err={row['error_rate']*100:.2f}% cap={row['capacity_units']}")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

# 6. Issues
try:
    sec("ISSUES")
    r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues GROUP BY status")
    print("  by status:", [(row['status'],row['n']) for row in r['rows']])
    r = nm.query("SELECT days_open, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY days_open ORDER BY days_open")
    print("  open backlog by days_open:", [(row['days_open'],row['n']) for row in r['rows']])
    r = nm.query("SELECT open_day, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE open_day>=43 GROUP BY open_day ORDER BY open_day")
    print("  arrivals/day:", [(row['open_day'],row['n']) for row in r['rows']])
    r = nm.query("SELECT AVG(resolved_day-open_day) as avg_days, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day>=43 AND resolved_day<=49")
    print(f"  resolved wk7: n={r['rows'][0]['n']} avg_fix_days={r['rows'][0]['avg_days']:.2f}" if r['rows'][0]['n'] else "  none resolved")
    r = nm.query("SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY group_id")
    print("  open by group:", [(row['group_id'],row['n']) for row in r['rows']])
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

# 7. Rebill forecast next 4 weeks (billing_day_mod30)
try:
    sec("REBILL FORECAST (active subs, effective_price)")
    for wk, (d0, d1) in [(8,(50,56)),(9,(57,63)),(10,(64,70)),(11,(71,77))]:
        mods = [d%30 for d in range(d0,d1+1)]
        modstr = ",".join(str(m) for m in mods)
        r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) as n, SUM(effective_price*seat_count) as rev FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND billing_day_mod30 IN ({modstr})")
        print(f"  wk{wk} (d{d0}-{d1}): n={r['rows'][0]['n']} rev=${r['rows'][0]['rev']:.0f}")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

# 8. Subs snapshot by group/plan/price
try:
    sec("ACTIVE SUBS by group/plan/price")
    r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, s.effective_price, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
                    WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan, s.effective_price ORDER BY c.group_id, n DESC""")
    mrr=0
    for row in r['rows']:
        print(f"  {row['group_id']} {row['plan']} @${row['effective_price']:.0f} x{row['n']}")
        mrr+=row['effective_price']*row['n']
    print(f"  MRR=${mrr:.0f}")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

# 9. Social posts last 7d
try:
    sec("SOCIAL POSTS last 7d")
    posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=30)
    plist = posts if isinstance(posts, list) else posts.get('posts', posts)
    for p in plist:
        try:
            print(f"  [{p.get('day','?')}] {p.get('author_name',p.get('author','?'))} ({p.get('group_id','?')}): {str(p.get('content',''))[:110]}")
        except Exception as e2:
            print("  post parse err", e2, p)
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

# 10. Enterprise open threads
try:
    sec("ENTERPRISE turns open")
    r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0")
    print("  open threads:", r['rows'][0]['n'])
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

# 11. Cancellations wk7
try:
    sec("CANCELLATIONS wk7")
    r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, s.effective_price, s.end_day FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
                    WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>=43""")
    for row in r['rows']:
        print(f"  {row['group_id']} {row['plan']} @${row['effective_price']:.0f} end d{row['end_day']}")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

# 12. Last-day usage run rate + per-sub avg
try:
    sec("USAGE per sub")
    r = nm.query(f"SELECT SUM(usage_units) as u, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as n FROM daily_usage WHERE day={D-1}")
    row=r['rows'][0]
    print(f"  d{D-1}: total={row['u']} across {row['n']} custs = {row['u']/max(row['n'],1):.1f}/cust")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e)

import math

def phi(x):
    return 0.5*(1+math.erf(x/math.sqrt(2)))

def run(eff_per_k=148, mu0=0.273, sigma=0.060, drift=0.0004, qrate=0.0024,
        net_rate=0.013, churn_cycle=0.04, price_raise_day=63, bar14=0.034,
        conv_cap=0.97, compute_per_sub_wk=0.728, verbose=True):
    cash = 333154.0
    subs = 1341.0
    mrr = 16011.0            # billed monthly recurring (effective)
    delivered0 = 0.3044
    # known rebill schedule for wk8-11 (from DB)
    known_rebills = {8: 1140, 9: 2856, 10: 3852, 11: 6324}
    # cohort queue: list of (week_added, monthly_value) for rebills starting ~4.3wk later
    cohort_mrr = []          # (wk, $)
    out = {}
    for wk in range(8, 8+33):   # through week 40 (day ~280)
        day_mid = 49 + (wk-8)*7 + 3.5
        # leads
        content_leads = 700*eff_per_k/1000.0
        network_leads = net_rate*subs
        leads_d = content_leads + network_leads
        leads_w = leads_d*7
        # conversion
        delivered = delivered0 + qrate*(day_mid-49)
        mu = mu0 + drift*(day_mid-49)
        price = 12.0 if day_mid < price_raise_day else 14.0
        shift = 0.0 if price < 13 else bar14
        conv = min(conv_cap, phi((delivered - mu - shift)/sigma))
        new_subs = leads_w*conv
        # rebills
        if wk in known_rebills:
            rebills = known_rebills[wk]
        else:
            # cohorts older than ~4.3 weeks rebill weekly at mrr/4.345
            mature_mrr = mrr_base + sum(v for (w, v) in cohort_mrr if wk - w >= 4)
            rebills = mature_mrr/4.345
        # churn: 4% per 30d cycle on subscriber base
        churn_w = subs*(churn_cycle/4.345)
        # money in
        cash_in = new_subs*price + rebills
        # costs
        dev = 17500 if day_mid < 112 else 9100
        ads = 4900
        ops = 3220
        cap = 1505 if wk == 8 else 3710
        usage_avg = subs*52
        if usage_avg*1.6 > 800000:
            cap = 13300   # T3 guess ~1900/d
        compute = subs*compute_per_sub_wk
        leadcost = leads_w*0.5
        cash_out = dev+ads+ops+cap+compute+leadcost
        cash += cash_in - cash_out
        # update state
        mrr_new = new_subs*price
        cohort_mrr.append((wk, mrr_new))
        subs = subs + new_subs - churn_w
        mrr = mrr + mrr_new - mrr*(churn_cycle/4.345)
        day_end = 49 + (wk-7)*7
        out[day_end] = (cash, subs, conv, rebills, cash_in, cash_out)
        if verbose and wk <= 40:
            print(f"wk{wk} d{day_end}: cash={cash/1000:7.1f}K subs={subs:6.0f} conv={conv*100:4.1f}% "
                  f"rebill={rebills/1000:5.2f}K IN={cash_in/1000:5.1f}K OUT={cash_out/1000:5.1f}K net={(cash_in-cash_out)/1000:+6.1f}K")
    return out

# mrr_base: MRR of subs already active at day 49 (they rebill from wk12 on schedule ~ mrr/4.345)
mrr_base = 16011.0

print("=== BASE CASE ===")
base = run()

print("\n=== PESSIMISTIC (saturation 120/$K, higher drift, worse $14 hit, churn 6%) ===")
pess = run(eff_per_k=120, drift=0.0009, bar14=0.050, churn_cycle=0.06, net_rate=0.010, qrate=0.0021)

print("\n=== OPTIMISTIC (eff 162, low drift, mild $14 hit, churn 3%) ===")
opt = run(eff_per_k=162, drift=0.0002, bar14=0.025, churn_cycle=0.03, net_rate=0.015)

for d in (56, 77, 133, 231):
    print(f"day {d}: base={base[d][0]/1000:.0f}K pess={pess[d][0]/1000:.0f}K opt={opt[d][0]/1000:.0f}K")

# NovaMind CEO Memory (updated Day 56 / Week 8)

## GOAL: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score.

## ⚠️ DO WEEK 9 (day 63)
1. **Check content eff @1000/d** (was 162/$K @700, no saturation 550→700). If ≥140 → raise to 1300/d. If <120 → back to 850.
2. **Conv check** (expect ~79-82% @$12). Update μ: solve Φ((del_mid−μ)/0.060)=conv. If z=(del−μ)/0.06 tracking → confirm $14 raise at DAY 77 (not 63! margin+flywheel math: raise when z≥1.33; z(d77)≈1.43). $16 when z12≥2.5 (~day 105).
3. **Post #10: E3 warm-up** — co-development partnership angle + enterprise case study (E3 post feedback: that's what "triggers direct outreach"). Prepping for linkedin E3 ads ~day 70-77.
4. Watch T2 charge ($530/d from d57) + auto week report output (registered script).
5. E3 unlock ~day 87 (raw 0.4642 d56, +0.00653/d → 0.668). Linkedin E3 ads start day 70-77 @ ~$100-150/d.

## KEY MECHANICS (verified)
- Delivered = (0.20 base + global_bonus + group_bonus) × tier_mult. T1 .60/T2 .75/T3 .90/T4 1.00/T5 1.10. Compute $/unit by MODEL tier: T2 .002, T4 .012.
- Capacity: T2 800K/$530d (current, from d57). T3 2.5M/$1330d — buy when subs ~9K (~day 95). T4 8M/$4000d @ ~30K subs.
- Dev: targeted 0.0225·ln(1+$/5000)/d raw: 300→.00131, 600→.00255, 1200→.00484. Global @1000/d → +.00169/d raw observed (formula says .00082 — trust observed). Group bonus BANKED forever.
- S1 delivered gain now .00225/d (global+S1-300, ×0.75 tier).
- GRANDFATHERING: price locked at signup. Raise affects new leads only. NO promos ever.
- Leads eval ONCE. $0.5/lead. Rebill every 30d; retention ~97%/cycle (5 cancels/174 rebills wk8).
- ⚠️ DASHBOARD DAY N = day N ALREADY PROCESSED (usage/billing/spend posted). Forecast window = days N+1..N+7. Rebills for window = mod30 ∈ {(N+1)%30..(N+7)%30}.
- S1 CONV MODEL: conv = Φ((delivered−μ)/0.060) − ~0.03 model bias. μ≈0.274 @d52, drift ~+0.0003/d. Price slope: $12→$14 shifts bar +0.034 (−0.567σ). Data: d42 0.291→62%, d49 0.304→70%, d56 0.320→73.3%.
- $14 raise rule: raise when 14Φ(z−.567)>12Φ(z) → z≥1.33 → day 77. Margin check (compute $4.5/sub/mo): also passes. Flywheel favors slight delay — day 77 it is.
- R&D: T1 +0.0289/$167K, T2 +0.0619/$333K done. PAUSED. Rule: buy only if cash-after ≥$220K AND (wk net>−10K OR cash>$400K). Earliest ~day 150+.
- customers PK customer_id. subscriptions.status ∈ {lead,subscribed,cancelled,lost} (NOT 'active'). issues: open_day/days_open/status/resolved_day. ad_channel_leads: channel_id, group_id, leads_generated, spend (per day). daily_usage: day, customer_id, usage_units. config_history = day-level global config; config_overrides = targeted settings JSON. Weekend usage dips ~45% (d54-55); weekday/sub ~81 units, blended 74.8.

## GROUP INTEL (lvl 1, ±65%)
- S1: WTP $25.9, cap 272,812 (1% used). 2,028 subs. Wants pricing simplicity/free tier in posts.
- S2: 19 subs A@$12. WTP $178. Conv 3/5 wk8. Parked.
- S3: 3 subs B@$39. Leads all lost (bar>delivered). Parked; likes technical posts.
- E3: cap 86 cos, seats 324-1906, WTP $104/seat, q_min 0.668 (raw, C=T4). 18 rounds, slow. PMI 46.1 E-budgets frozen — need ROI case. Post feedback: wants co-development + case studies.
- Network referrals: 0.0155/sub/d observed wk8 (174/wk @ ~1,600 avg subs), conv ~70%+. Rising with reputation.

## CHANNEL ECONOMICS
- content S1: 162/$K @550 AND @700 (no saturation yet). Testing 1000/d (set d56). CAC ~$8-9. search 51/$K, social 46/$K — dead.
- Marginal ad $ pays back <1 week at current conv (150×.162×.78×$12 ≈ $228/d per $150/d). Scale until eff <~100 or cash floor.

## STATE day 56 (post-actions)
- Cash $313.5K. Wk8 (d49-55 ledger): IN 9.2K, OUT 29.1K → net −19.9K. Day 56 already posted (in cash).
- Subs 2,050: S1 1,982@$12 + 45@$9 + 1 B@$39; S2 19@$12; S3 3 B@$39. MRR ~$24.8K.
- Quality: global bonus 0.1625 (+.00169/d), S1 grp 0.0642, E3 grp 0.1016, S2 0.2025, S3 0.0275. Delivered: S1-A 0.3201, E3-C 0.4642 (raw), S2-A 0.4238.
- Usage: weekday ~157K (d56), weekend ~90K. T2 cap 800K — headroom to ~9.5K subs.
- Issues: instant resolution (943/wk @0.001d avg), 157 open incl zombie #583 (cust 187 CANCELLED — cleared S1 targeted ops d56). LESSON: check cust status before chasing stuck issues.
- Config d56: A/B/C $12/$39/$149, tiers 2/2/4, quotas 200/650/2500. Cap T2. Dev 1000 global + S1 300 + E3 1200. Ops 500 global, no targeted. Ads content S1 1000/d only. Post #9 (batch API + whitepaper tease) live d56.
- Rebill windows (from mod30 table d56): d57-63 $2,856(243) · d64-70 $3,852(325) · d71-77 $6,324(527) · d78-84 $8,886(736, incl d50-55 cohort). Cohorts signed ≥d56 rebill +30d later (mod = signup%30).

## STRATEGY
1. S1 flywheel: content 1000/d (test), scale if eff holds; network 0.0155/sub/d compounds. $14 @ day 77, $16 @ ~day 105 (z rules). Old cohorts grandfathered & sticky (tenure loyalty).
2. E3 = prize. Dev 1200/d until raw ≥0.668 (~day 87) then CUT E3 dev (+8.4K/wk relief), shift ~300 to S1 (→600). Linkedin ads d70-77. Deal math: 500 seats@$50-70 ≈ $25-35K/mo. Warm up via post #10.
3. Trough ~$240-245K around day 91-95 (pre-T3). Floors: cash <$150K cut E3 dev; <$100K ads→300.
4. T3 at subs ~9K (~day 95). R&D revisit ~day 150 (rule above). research_market() revisit when cash-positive (~day 112+).
5. HARVEST last ~8-10 wks: dev→0, trim ads, milk rebills.

## FORECAST MODEL (wk9+, settings d56)
- OUT/wk: dev 17.5 + ads 7.0 + ops 3.5 + cap 3.71 + compute (avg_subs×74.8×7×$0.002) + leads (~0.67) ≈ 35K at 2.5K subs.
- IN/wk: new = leads×conv×$12 (leads/d = 1000×~.155 + .0155×subs); rebills per window table ×0.97.
- Growth: adds ~150/d wk9 → ~210/d wk11. Subs: d63 ~3.0K, d70 ~4.3K, d77 ~5.75K, d84 ~7.2K.
- Net/wk: −19.5 (wk9) → −17 (wk10) → −14 (wk11) → −10 (wk12, $14 starts) → trough d91-95 → positive ~d98+.

## FORECASTS SUBMITTED (day 56, cash 313.5K)
- 1wk (d63) 294K [288, 300]; 4wk (d84) 252.5K [236, 268]; 12wk (d140) 340K [225, 480]; 26wk (d238) 850K [380, 2100]
- Assumptions: conv 79%→88% ($12) then $14 d77 ~81%; content eff ~155/$K @1000; network .0155/sub/d; retention 97%; T3 d~95; E3 dev cut d~87-90; 12wk incl $14/$16 ladder, no R&D spend before d140; 26wk incl E3 deals EV +30K/wk late + R&D buys ~400-800K discretionary.
- Track record 1wk: d14✓ d21✓ d28✓ d35✓ d42✓ d49✓ (6/6, all within ±2K).

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID
- ONE tool call per turn. Batch via python scripts; try/except each section.
- `./novamind-operation python script.py` output can get swallowed by dashboard reprint — verify actions via config_history/config_overrides queries.
- Don't touch ads_strength (in-app ads degrade quality). Posts ≤280 chars, 1/wk (#9 used d56).
- No E-bait pre-quality ~0.55 raw. No lead promos.
- next-week: rationale + 12 numbers. Forecast = cash at NEXT dashboard (that day fully processed).
- Post scores: concrete metrics good; S1 needs pricing mention; E3 needs partnership/case-study angle.
- Weekly auto-report registered (daily_scripts/week_report.py) — reads new subs, ad eff, rebills, ledger, usage, issues each week start.

# NovaMind CEO Memory (updated Day 63 / Week 9)

## GOAL: Maximize CASH at day 504 (72 weeks). Cash = score.

## ⚠️ DO WEEK 10 (day 70)
1. **Check content eff @1800/d + referral eff @250/d** (blended content was 198/$K @1000: weekday ~220, weekend ~130). Rules: content eff ≥160 → consider 2500/d; <120 → back to 1200. Referral ≥80/$K → keep/scale; <40 → cut to 0.
2. **T3 WATCH**: buy T3 (2.5M cap, $1330/d) when weekday usage ≥650K (~8,000 subs). Expected ~day 79-82 (earlier than old d95 plan — growth is faster). Peak d63 was 252K.
3. **Conv check**: expect ~79-82% @$12 (z mid-wk ≈ 0.99). Update μ: μ = delivered_mid − Φ⁻¹(conv+0.03)×0.060. If z(d77) ≥ 1.33 → **set A=$14 at day 77 dashboard** (week 11). Currently on track: z(d77) proj 1.48.
4. Watch first-rebill churn + ops resolution speed (avg days_open of resolved; if >0.1d → raise ops toward 1200).
5. E3: raw 0.5074 @d63, +0.00618/d → 0.668 ~**day 89**. At unlock: E3 dev→0, S1 dev 800→1100, linkedin E3 ads ~120/d, reference post #10 design-partner program in negotiation.

## KEY MECHANICS (verified)
- Delivered = (0.20 base + global_bonus + group_bonus) × tier_mult. T1 .60/T2 .75/T3 .90/T4 1.00/T5 1.10. Compute $/unit by MODEL tier: T2 .002, T4 .012.
- Capacity: T2 800K/$530d (current). T3 2.5M/$1330d. T4 8M/$4000d (~30K subs, ~d126).
- Dev targeted/d: 0.0225·ln(1+$/5000) raw → 300→.00131, 800→.00348, 1200→.00484. Global @1000/d → +.00134/d raw observed (was .00169, declining). S1 delivered gain now (.00134+.00348)×0.75 = **.00362/d**; z growth .047/d.
- GRANDFATHERING: price locked at signup. Raise affects new leads only. NO promos ever.
- Leads eval ONCE. $0.5/lead. Rebill every 30d. Retention **95.5%/cycle** (12 cancels/240 rebills wk9; 10 were first-rebill). New subs PAY $12 AT SIGNUP (verified in ledger).
- ⚠️ DASHBOARD DAY N = day N already processed. Forecast = cash at next dashboard.
- S1 CONV MODEL: conv = Φ((delivered−μ)/0.060) − 0.03. **μ(d63)=0.2845, drift +0.0008/d.** z(d63)=0.825. Data: d42 .291→62%, d49 .304→70%, d56 .320→73.3%, d63 mid .327→74.3%.
- Price ladder: $14 when z12≥1.33 (→day 77 ✓proj). $16 when z12≥2.5 (→ ~day 99; check d98: delivered−μ ≥ 0.15). $12→$14 shifts bar +0.567σ.
- R&D: T1 +0.0289/$167K, T2 +0.0619/$333K done. PAUSED. Rule: buy only if cash-after ≥$220K AND (wk net>−10K OR cash>$400K). Earliest ~day 133-140 (T1 repeat ~167K).
- Issues: dashboard "open issues" = TODAY'S arrivals (resolution same-day, avg 0.0007d @ops 500-800). Arrivals ~0.08/sub/d. Only zombies = cancelled custs' issues (harmless). Scale ops with subs: ~1200/d @8K subs, 1500/d @12K.
- Tables: subscriptions.status ∈ {lead,subscribed,cancelled,lost}; effective_price, start_day, end_day, billing_day_mod30. ad_channel_leads per day. config_overrides = targeted JSON. Weekend: usage/sub 49.5 vs weekday 82 (blended 72.7); ad eff also dips ~40% weekends.

## GROUP INTEL (lvl 1, ±65%)
- S1: WTP $25.9, cap 272,812 (1.2% used). 3,259 subs. Loves concrete metrics/cost-cut posts.
- S2: 24 subs A@$12 (conv 6/10 wk9). S3: 5 B@$39 (3/25). Parked.
- E3: cap 86 cos, seats 324-1906, WTP $104/seat, q_min 0.668 raw (C=T4). 18 rounds, slow. PMI 49.0 rising (budget thaw). Wants co-development + case studies → post #10 (d63) = design-partner program.
- Network referrals: **0.0134/sub/d** organic leads (28-55/d @ ~2,900 subs wk9).

## CHANNEL ECONOMICS
- content S1: 162/$K @550-700 → **198/$K @1000** (rising w/ reputation!). Now 1800/d. CAC ~$7. Payback <1wk (new subs pay $12 on signup).
- referral_program S1: 250/d TEST started d63 (eff unknown). search 51, social 46 — dead.
- Marginal $1K/d ads @eff 180, conv .78 → +140 subs/d → +$1.7K/d immediate rev. Self-funding — scale until eff <~120 or cash floor.

## STATE day 63 (post-actions)
- Cash $296.0K. Wk9 ledger (d56-62): IN 16.4K, OUT 34.4K → net −17.9K.
- Subs 3,288: S1 3,259 (mostly A@$12, 43@$9), S2 24, S3 5. MRR $39.5K.
- Quality: global bonus 0.1719 (+.00134/d), S1 grp 0.0734, E3 grp 0.1355. Delivered: S1-A 0.3340, E3-C raw 0.5074, S2-A 0.4309.
- Usage: weekday ~82/sub (peak 252K d63), weekend ~49.5/sub. T2 cap 800K → T3 at ~8K subs.
- Config d63: A/B/C $12/$39/$149, tiers 2/2/4, quotas 200/650/2500. Cap T2. Dev 1000 global + S1 800 + E3 1200. Ops 800 global. Ads: content S1 1800 + referral S1 250. Post #10 live d63.
- Rebills: d64-70 $3,852 (325) · d71-77 $6,324 (527) · d78-84 $8,886 (736) · d85-91 ≈ cohorts d25-31+d55-61 ≈ $15K. Cohorts signed ≥d57 rebill from d87 (mega-waves begin).
- Social: post #9 loved by all groups; 1 mild S1 gripe (slowness); PMI 49.0. No competitor launch wk9.

## STRATEGY
1. S1 flywheel: ads 2050/d total, dev S1 800; conv → 80%+; $14 d77, $16 ~d99. Old cohorts grandfathered & sticky.
2. E3 = prize. Dev 1200/d until raw ≥0.668 (~d89), then cut → +8.4K/wk relief, shift 300 to S1. Linkedin E3 ads from unlock. Deal: 500 seats@$50-70 = $25-35K/mo.
3. Trough now ~$230-240K around day 88-93 (T3 + $14 transition). Floors: cash <$150K cut E3 dev; <$100K ads→300.
4. Breakeven ~day 93 proj. R&D revisit ~d133+ (rule above). research_market() when solidly cash-positive (~d112+).
5. HARVEST last ~8-10 wks: dev→0, trim ads, milk rebills.

## FORECAST MODEL (wk10 params)
- Leads/d = content 1800×~0.180 + referral 250×? + 0.0134×subs. Conv ~0.79 avg wk10.
- OUT/wk: dev 21 + ads 14.35 + ops 5.6 + cap 3.71 + compute (avg_subs×72.7×7×$0.002) + leads×$0.5 ≈ 50.6K @ 4.4K avg subs.
- IN/wk: new_subs×$12 + rebill_window×0.955.
- Proj subs: d70 ~5.4K, d77 ~7.9K, d84 ~10.5K, d91 ~13.5K. Net/wk: −20.7 (wk10) → −17 (wk11) → −15 (wk12, $14+T3) → −8 (wk13) → +7 (wk14) → positive.

## FORECASTS SUBMITTED (day 63, cash 296.0K)
- 1wk (d70) 275K [266, 282]; 4wk (d91) 236K [205, 262]; 12wk (d147) 500K [310, 700]; 26wk (d245) 1.40M [550K, 3.0M]
- Assumptions: content eff ~180 @1800, referral ~40-60, conv .79→.86, retention 95.5%, T3 ~d80, $14 d77 (conv ~.80-.85), $16 ~d99, E3 dev cut d89, breakeven d93; 12wk: maybe 1 R&D buy 167K ~d140 (mid-scenario), partial E3 EV; 26wk: T4 ~d126, R&D 2 buys, E3 deals EV, cap-growth drag.
- Track record 1wk: d14✓ d21✓ d28✓ d35✓ d42✓ d49✓ d63✓ (7/7).

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID
- ONE tool call per turn. Batch via python scripts; try/except each section.
- Verify actions via config_overrides/config_history queries (script output can be swallowed).
- Don't touch ads_strength (in-app ads degrade quality). Posts ≤280 chars, 1/wk (#10 used d63).
- No E-bait pre-quality ~0.55 raw. No lead promos. Check cust status before chasing stuck issues.
- next-week: rationale + 12 numbers, lower ≤ point ≤ upper.
- "Open issues" spike on dashboard ≠ backlog — check resolved_day data before reacting.
- Weekly auto-report registered (daily_scripts/week_report.py).

print(f"=== WK10 ANALYSIS day {DAY} ===")

# 1) Ledger by category last week
print("\n1) LEDGER d63-69 & d64-70:")
for lo,hi in [(63,69),(64,70)]:
    rows = q(f"SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
    tot = sum(r['amt'] for r in rows if 'amt' in r and r['amt'])
    print(f"  d{lo}-{hi} net={tot:.0f}")
    for r in rows: print("   ", r)

# 2) Ad channel efficiency by day
print("\n2) AD LEADS by channel/day d64-70:")
rows = q(f"SELECT day, channel_id ch, SUM(leads_generated) n, SUM(spend) sp FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 64 AND 70 GROUP BY day, ch ORDER BY day")
for r in rows: print("   ", r)
rows = q(f"SELECT channel_id ch, SUM(leads_generated) n, SUM(spend) sp FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 64 AND 70 GROUP BY ch")
for r in rows:
    eff = 1000.0*r['n']/r['sp'] if r['sp'] else 0
    print(f"   TOTAL {r['ch']}: leads={r['n']} spend={r['sp']:.0f} eff={eff:.0f}/$K")

# 3) Leads & conversion by group by day (last 7d)
print("\n3) LEADS/CONV by group d64-70:")
rows = q("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.start_day d, s.status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 64 AND 70 GROUP BY g, d, s.status ORDER BY g, d""")
agg = {}
for r in rows:
    key=(r['g'],r['d']); agg.setdefault(key,{'sub':0,'tot':0})
    agg[key]['tot'] += r['n']
    if r['status'] in ('subscribed','cancelled'): agg[key]['sub'] += r['n']
for (g,d),v in sorted(agg.items()):
    print(f"   {g} d{d}: {v['sub']}/{v['tot']} = {v['sub']/max(1,v['tot']):.3f}")
# weekly totals per group
gg={}
for (g,d),v in agg.items():
    gg.setdefault(g,{'sub':0,'tot':0}); gg[g]['sub']+=v['sub']; gg[g]['tot']+=v['tot']
for g,v in sorted(gg.items()): print(f"   WEEK {g}: {v['sub']}/{v['tot']} = {v['sub']/max(1,v['tot']):.3f}")

# 4) Usage by day last 7d
print("\n4) USAGE by day d64-70:")
rows = q("SELECT day, SUM(usage_units) u, COUNT(*) users FROM daily_usage WHERE day BETWEEN 64 AND 70 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day")
for r in rows: print(f"   d{r['day']}: {r['u']:.0f} units, {r['users']} users, {r['u']/max(1,r['users']):.1f}/user")

# 5) Issues resolution speed
print("\n5) ISSUES resolved d64-70 (speed):")
rows = q("SELECT COUNT(*) n, AVG(resolved_day - created_day) avg_open FROM issues WHERE resolved_day BETWEEN 64 AND 70")
for r in rows: print("   ", r)
rows = q("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE created_day BETWEEN 64 AND 70 GROUP BY status")
for r in rows: print("   created this wk:", r)

# 6) Rebill schedule next 8 weeks (from active subs, no churn adj)
print("\n6) REBILL schedule (gross $ and count by week):")
rows = q("SELECT billing_day_mod30 m, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY m")
mod = {r['m']: (r['n'], r['amt']) for r in rows}
for w in range(8):
    lo, hi = DAY+1+7*w, DAY+7+7*w
    n=amt=0
    for d in range(lo,hi+1):
        # sub rebills on day d if d%30==billing_day_mod30 AND started at least 30d before? approx: all active
        nn,aa = mod.get(d%30,(0,0)); n+=nn; amt+=aa or 0
    print(f"   wk d{lo}-{hi}: {n} rebills, ${amt:.0f} gross")

print("   correction: subs started within 30d of rebill day are excluded going forward (rough check)")
rows = q(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day > {DAY-30+7}")

# 8) Enterprise turns open?

rows = q("SELECT thread_type, status, COUNT(*) n, MAX(day) last_day FROM enterprise_turns GROUP BY thread_type, status")

# NovaMind CEO Memory (updated Day 77 / Week 11)

## GOAL: Maximize CASH at day 504. Cash = score.

## ⚠️ REGIME CHANGE: COMPETITOR ARMS RACE (d69-77)
Launch posts EVERY day d71-77 (mag 0.03-0.09) but only BIG pair-events hit S1: d70 (+0.057 μ) and d74 (+0.059 μ). Others ≈ zero S1 effect.
- **μ_S1(d77) ≈ 0.410** (fit from daily conv; stable/noisy-flat d74-77 0.398-0.410 → events DON'T decay, but no daily drift either).
- Conv model VERIFIED again: conv = Φ((delivered−μ)/0.060) − 0.03. Daily conv d71-73: 0.53/0.556/0.549 (μ 0.347 ✓ pre-d74), d74-77: 0.203/0.29/0.281/0.259.
- Observed S1-event rate: 2 per 8d during burst. Unknown if burst or new normal — pre-d69 was calm for weeks (μ flat 0.289). EV assume ~1/wk during burst, watch for calm.
- Fit method: z = Φ⁻¹(conv+0.03); μ = delivered − 0.06z. Delivered S1-A d77 = 0.3766 (dashboard).
- $14 gate: z≥1.33 → need delivered ≥ μ+0.08 → nowhere close (z −0.56 now). HOLD $12.

## ⚠️ DO WEEK 12 (day 84)
1. **Event check FIRST**: query social posts d78+; fit daily conv (customers⋈subscriptions by created_day). If new S1 event → μ += ~0.057.
2. **Triggers**: wk avg conv <0.20 → cut content 2400→1500, referral 500→300. conv ≥0.32 → hold all. ≥0.40 → consider content 3000. Retention: cancels/736 rebills >12% → harvest tilt (trim ads, protect rebills).
3. **E3 unlock ~d93** (E3-C delivered 0.5825 @d77 +0.0052/d → 0.668 @ ~d93; +global residual may pull to d91-92). NEXT WEEK (d84): if on track, set linkedin E3 ads ~120/d starting immediately (leads need lead time; response slow). At unlock: E3 dev→0, S1 stays 1300.
4. **E3 DEAL ECONOMICS (critical, from insights d77)**: q_min 0.668, WTP $104/seat, seats 324-1906, 18 decision rounds, avg response 23.8d (ALL ±65% noise). Usage 137.5 u/seat/d × T4 $0.012 = **$49.5/seat/mo compute** → must price $90-120/seat (open $115-120, settle ≥$85). Margin @$100×500 seats ≈ $25K/mo. First revenue realistic d115-140. Consider research_group(E3) (~$? check cost) before pricing if cash allows.
5. Ops 1000 OK (resolution same-day: avg 0.007d resolved, arrivals 693/d ≈ 9.3% of subs, stable rate). Bump ~1200 when subs >10K OR if avg days_open >0.5.
6. Cash floors: <150K → cut E3 dev (moot post-unlock); <120K → content 1200; <100K → ads 300 total.

## KEY MECHANICS (verified)
- Delivered = (0.20 + global_bonus + grp_bonus) × tier_mult. T2 .75, T4 1.00. Compute: T2 $.002/unit, T4 $.012.
- GLOBAL DEV SATURATED (killed d70, stays 0). Global bonus still crept +0.0027 in wk11 with $0 spend (residual/lag?) — don't count on it.
- Targeted dev: 0.0225·ln(1+$/5000) raw/d. 1300→0.00521 raw → S1 delivered +0.0039/d (T2). E3 +0.0052/d (T4).
- GRANDFATHERING: price locked at signup. Leads eval ONCE ($0.5/lead). New subs PAY at signup. Rebill every 30d.
- **Retention gentler than acquisition**: 92.2% @ z≈−0.55 (was 95.5% @ z≈+0.6) → ~−3pt per −1z. Tenure bonus up to +0.13 @12mo. LTV ~$60-95 vs CAC ~$12 → ads stay EV+ even in bear.
- S1 market cap ~273K ±65% — not binding (7.4K subs). WTP S1 $25.9 ±65%.
- Weekend = days ≡5,6 mod 7 (usage ~49/sub vs 89-93 weekday; blended 72.7 → $0.1454/sub/d compute @T2). Ad eff −45% weekends.
- E3 reputation OUTGOING huge (E2 .47, E1 .36, S3 .28) — landing E3 lifts enterprise reputation broadly.
- R&D: PAUSED. Rule: buy only if cash-after ≥220K AND (wk net>−10K OR cash>400K). T1 ~$167K (+0.029).
- Table gotchas: issues = open_day/days_open/resolved_day/status. social_media_posts = post_id/day/content/source_group_id (no sentiment). enterprise_turns has `closed`. customers has created_day + acquisition_source. Dashboard "Open Issues" ≈ today's arrivals.
- ONE tool call per turn (re-confirmed d77 — parallel calls skipped). Batch inside python scripts.

## STATE day 77 (post-actions)
- Cash $243.2K. Wk11: IN 28.7K (2,385 pmts), OUT 62.0K (ads 20.3, dev 16.1, cap 9.31, ops 7, compute 6.9, leads 2.36) → net −33.3K.
- Subs 7,423 (all ≈ S1 A@$12). Cancels 41/wk (92.2% retention on 527 rebills).
- Quality: global 0.1767, S1 grp 0.1255, E3 grp 0.2058. Delivered: S1-A 0.3766 (+0.0039/d w/ 1300 dev), E3-C 0.5825 (+0.0052/d).
- Leads d71-77: 673/d = content 485 (202/$K @2400 ✓) + referral 77 (153/$K @500 ✓) + organic/network 113 (rate ≈ 0.0153×subs, was 0.0134). Conv by source similar (0.36-0.41).
- Spend: dev S1 1300 + E3 1300 (set d77), ops 1000, ads content S1 2400 + referral S1 500. Cap T3 ($1330/d, 2.5M units). Usage 3.47M/wk.
- Rebills gross (fresh d77 query): d78-84 736/$8.9K · d85-91 1,273/$15.3K · d92-98 2,494/$29.9K · d99-105 2,460/$29.6K · d106-112 985/$11.9K (+wk12 cohort adds).
- PMI 49.0 recovering/neutral. Post #12 (weekly-ship/support/[$12 no lock-in]) live d77. Posts: S1 loves $12+no-lock-in; gripes: quota (#139), old bug (#164).
- T4 trigger: weekday usage ≥2.1M ≈ 26K subs — FAR now (conv crash slowed growth), maybe d130+.

## STRATEGY
1. S1 flywheel at $12: hold ads (CAC $11.9 breakeven day-one, LTV 5-8×), dev 1300 fights μ race. Quality race: delivered +0.117/mo vs events EV +0.06-0.25/mo — if burst persists conv pins 0.10-0.25; if calm returns conv → 0.5-0.7. DON'T panic-cut unless cash floors hit.
2. E3 = prize (~$25K/mo margin/deal, 86 cos). Unlock ~d93. Price $90-120/seat (compute $49.5!). Slow negotiation → start ads d84-91.
3. Trough deeper than planned: ~140K @ d105 (was 205-215K). Rebill waves d92-105 ($59.5K gross) + E3 = recovery. Breakeven ~d105-115.
4. research_market ($25K) only when cash >200K AND trajectory positive (~d120+). Harvest last ~8 wks: dev→0, trim ads, milk rebills.

## FORECAST MODEL (wk12 params)
- Leads/d ≈ content 485 + referral 77 + 0.0145×subs. Conv EV wk12 0.26 (event-prob-weighted: no-event 0.34, 1-event 0.22; p~0.65).
- OUT/wk: dev 18.2 + ads 20.3 + ops 7 + cap 9.31 + compute (avg_subs×0.1454×7) + leads (n×0.5) ≈ 65.3K.
- Wk12 IN ≈ 14.6 signup + 8.1 rebill = 22.7K → net −42.6K.
- Path: d84 ~200.7K, d91 ~165K (net −36), d98 ~150K (net −15, E3 dev off d93, rebill wave), d105 ~140K (net −10). Then slow climb.

## FORECASTS SUBMITTED (day 77, cash 243.2K)
- 1wk (d84) 200.5K [190K, 212K]; 4wk (d105) 140K [112K, 170K]; 12wk (d161) 230K [125K, 395K]; 26wk (d259) 420K [140K, 1.15M]

- Track record 1wk: 9/9 inside CI (d14-d77 ✓; d77 actual 243.2 vs [241,255]).

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID
- ONE tool call per turn. Verify actions via config_overrides. try/except every section.
- Don't touch ads_strength. Posts ≤280 chars 1/wk (#12 used d77). No promos ever (grandfathering). Don't raise quota A (compute margin zero at $12).

        # poisson draw

        while True:
            p *= random.random()

        # new cohorts rebills
        for c in list(cohorts):

                c[1] += 30/7.0
                if c[0] < 50: cohorts.remove(c)
        cohorts.append([sign_cash*1.0, w + 30/7.0, 10.0])
        subs10 = subs10*(ret10**(7/30.0)) + signups

        if not e3_active and w >= 4:

        e3_cash = e3_margin if e3_active else 0.0
        # costs

## GOAL: Maximize CASH at day 504. Cash = score.

## ⚠️ BIG MOVE d84: PRICE CUT A $12→$10 (experiment + trough defense)
- Rationale: μ_S1 hit ~0.449 (3rd straight event-week); conv wk12 = 0.167 (786/4704). d84 conv 0.214 recovering.

- **WK13 PROTOCOL: fit μ($10) from daily conv d85-91** (z=Φ⁻¹(conv+0.03); μ10 = delivered−0.06z; slope = (0.449+events−μ10)/2). Delivered S1-A(d) = 0.4041+0.00393×(d−84) while S1 dev 1300.
- **INTEGRITY CHECK wk13: SELECT AVG(effective_price) FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND listed_price=12 → must stay 12.0.** If base reprices to $10 → grandfathering broken → revert to $12 immediately.
- Decision d91: conv ≥0.45 → hold $10, consider content 2000. conv 0.28-0.45 → hold $10, content 1500. conv <0.25 AND no new events → slope tiny; consider revert $12 (new leads only, costless switch).

1. Event check FIRST (social posts d85+; even SMALL pair-posts ~0.03 hit S1 now: d78 0.0299 → μ +0.027. d79/d80 pairs hit only ~+0.01 combined. μ path: d77 0.409 → d84 ~0.446-0.452).

## GOAL: Maximize CASH at day 504. Cash = score.

## ⚠️ BIG MOVE d91: REVERTED A $10→$12 (new leads only; grandfathering verified 3-way: 42@$9, 1004@$10, 8008@$12 all avg_eff exact)
- $10 experiment DONE, slope measured: μ($10,d85)=0.4356 vs μ($12,d84)≈0.446+drift → **slope ≈ 0.006/$1 ± 0.003** (small).
- **MARGIN DISCOVERY (game-changer): marginal cost/sub ≈ $8-9/mo** (compute $4.4 + ops-scaling $3.5-4.5; issue arrivals = 9.8% of subs/DAY, ops $ per resolution ~$1.7-2.2). At $10 → margin $1-2/mo (≈breakeven!). At $12 → $3-4/mo. Margin-LTV/lead: $12 ≈ $13.5 vs $10 ≈ $11 → $12 wins. Book IN 24.3K/wk vs infra+ops 29.6K/wk — S1 book barely covers itself; ads+dev (31.6K/wk) is pure burn against future rebills. **ENTERPRISE (E3) is the only real margin in this business** (margin ~$45/seat/mo × 300-1900 seats).
- Cap T3 fixed $1330/d = $4.4/mo/sub at 9K subs (scale economies only kick in near 30K subs or by shrinking to T2 <~7.4K subs @600K units).

1. **Event check FIRST** (get_social_posts days=8). d91 pair-event 0.0421 may land d92 (μ +~0.035 if hit). Event history: d89 0.0305 NO-hit, d90 0.0433 HIT (+0.036), d91 ?. Hit rate ~50%, magnitude ~85% of posted number.

   - conv ≥0.20 → slope ≈ 0 → consider A=$13 (test again).
   - conv 0.10-0.17 → revert validated, HOLD $12.

3. **E3 dev 1300 STOPS d98**: set_targeted_dev_spend({"S1":1300}) ONLY. E3-C delivered d98 ≈ 0.696 (crossed q_min 0.668 ~d93; buffer vs drift ~5wk of enterprise μ drift).

If ≥1 thread: playbook → open C @$110-115/seat, concede $90, floor $85 (compute T4 = $49.5/seat/mo). WTP est $104±65%, seats 324-1906, 18 rounds, resp ~24d. deals=[[cid,[["C",110.0]]]]. REPLY WITHIN 7 DAYS or lead lost. If 0 leads by d105 → cut linkedin to 100 & investigate mechanics.
5. Ops: keep 1600 (open 918, age 0.33d, resolutions ~940/d ≈ arrivals 890/d). If subs >10K → consider 1750. If harvesting → 1000.

- OUT forecast: wk14 ~64K; wk15+ (E3 dev off) ~55K; floor-1 ~46K; floor-2 ~32.5K.

## STRATEGY (revised d91)
1. S1 at $12 = mildly-positive flywheel (content ROI ~$2.4/$1 over 14mo). Keep content 1500 until floor triggers. NOT the win condition.
2. **E3 = the win condition** (one deal ≈ $20-35K/mo margin ≈ entire S1 book). Quality unlocked d93. Watch turns weekly, never miss 7-day reply.
3. Trough path (planned): d98 ~127K → d105 ~105K (floor-1) → d112 ~80K (floor-2) → d119 ~70K → wk18-19 rebill waves stabilize. Survivable.
4. d119 harvest decision per DO-list #7. Last-8-weeks (d448+): always harvest (dev→0, ads taper, milk rebills).

## FORECASTS SUBMITTED (day 91, cash 156.66K)
- 1wk (d98) 126.5K [119K, 134K]; 4wk (d119) 70K [54K, 90K]; 12wk (d175) 72K [35K, 130K]; 26wk (d273) 120K [30K, 420K]

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID

# NovaMind CEO Memory (updated Day 98 / Week 14)

## GOAL: Maximize CASH at day 504. Cash = score.

## ⚠️ BIG MOVE d98: C list price $149→$99 to unlock E3 threads
- Found 42 enterprise leads (E1/E2/E3, all 'network' src) since d80 with NO subscription rows AND enterprise_turns COUNT = 0 EVER. They arrive (~5 E3 + 8 E1 + 8 E2 per wk, FREE) and are silently lost.
- Hypothesis: list-price screen — C=$149 >> E3 WTP est $104 → quality-required-at-$149 unreachable → lost before negotiating. At C=$99 (< WTP), required quality ≈ q_min floor 0.668; delivered E3-C = 0.6905 ✓ (crossed ~d93).
- E3 = win condition: seats 324-1906 × margin ~$50/seat/mo (compute T4 $49.5/seat/mo, WTP $104±65%). ONE deal ≈ entire S1 book.
- E3 dev STOPPED d98 (bonus 0.3150 frozen — VERIFY it persists next wk). Delivered E3-C decays only via global decay −0.0032/wk; buffer over 0.668 ≈ 0.0225 ≈ 5-7wk. RESTART E3 dev 1300 if a thread opens or buffer <0.01.

## ⚠️ DO WEEK 15 (day 105)
1. **enterprise_turns COUNT FIRST.** If ≥1: fetch rows, reply SAME DAY (7d timeout!). Playbook: offer C@$99, concede $92, floor $85. deals=[[cid,[["C",99.0]]]]. Expect ~5 E3 organic leads/wk now that C=$99.
2. If still 0 threads by d105: check E1/E2/E3 insights q_min vs delivered (E1/E2 C=0.3755, no grp bonus). Consider: is screen quality-based? E3 delivered 0.6905 vs q_min 0.668±65% — individual draws may fail. Options: restart E3 dev 1300 (+0.0052/d), or accept organic trickle. If linkedin still 0 paid E3 leads (200/d since d91, ~$2.8K, 0 leads) → cut linkedin to 0 (organic network flow doesn't need it; 5/wk arrive free).
3. **Floor-1 trigger: cash <110K → content 600/d** (keep linkedin if threads pending, dev S1 1300, ops 1600). Forecast says d105 ≈ 110K — right at line; trigger if below.
4. Floor-2 (cash <85K, likely d112): content 0, dev S1 650, **ops 1500 (REVISED from 1000 — ops 1000 = resolutions ~530/d vs arrivals ~950/d → issue explosion → churn kills 27K/wk rebills. Never starve ops below ~1500 while subs ~9.5K).**
5. Conv check: weekly conv ≥0.20 @$12 → consider A=$13 test (new leads only, costless, slope ~0.006/$1 ≈ −2.5pp conv, margin/sub +$1 = +29%). Daily conv was RISING d92-98: .152→.220 (delivered +0.0036/d > μ drift +0.002/d). Weekly 0.1769 (651/3681) — exactly no-event model prediction.
6. Harvest decision: was d119, EXTEND to d126 if E3 threads have opened (deal in flight = reason to keep book alive). If no threads by d119 AND conv <0.17 → harvest (ads 0, dev 0, ops scale ~1.6×arrivals$, T2 when usage <600K/d i.e. subs <8.3K; T2 = $530/d saves 5.6K/wk).

## KEY MECHANICS (verified)
- Delivered = (0.20 + global_bonus + grp_bonus) × tier_mult. T2 .75, T4 1.00. **Global bonus DECAYS −0.0032/wk when global dev = 0** (0.1787→0.1755). Targeted dev 1300 S1 → grp bonus +0.0365/wk (+0.0052/d); delivered S1-A net +0.0036/d. Grp bonus claims to persist after stop — TEST: E3 bonus was 0.3150 at d98 stop.
- conv = Φ((delivered−μ)/0.060) − 0.03. μ_S1($12) d94.5 ≈ 0.494; drift +0.002/d + event hits (+~85% of posted number). Event ledger: d89 NO, d90 HIT(+0.036), d91 NO(0.0421), d92 NO(0.0371) → hit rate ~4/13 (~31%). Retention/mo ≈ clip(0.955+0.03z,.84,.97); pay-rate 93%; cancels 166/wk ≈ 6.9% of rebills = normal.
- Leads/day: content 203/$K (linear), network 0.0155×subs (~1050/wk free), referral 140/$K (CUT d98 — worst ROI). Weekend 2 of 7 days −45% (this wk: d96,d97). Lead cost $0.5. Cross-group network into S3/S2/E* ~120/wk total.
- Margin/sub ≈ $3-4/mo at $12 (compute $4.4 + ops ~$3.5-4.5). Content ROI ~$2.4/$1 over 14mo, cash payback ~2.6mo.
- Prices affect NEW leads only (3-way verified: 41@$9, 1004@$10, 8487@$12). No promos ever (price-lock).
- SQL: customers PK **customer_id**, subscriptions PK **subscription_id** (NOT id). Enterprise leads = customers rows with NO subscriptions rows. issues: open_day, days_open, resolved_day. ledger categories: subscription_payment, advertising, development, operations, compute, capacity, lead_acquisition_cost.
- E3: WTP $104±65%, q_min 0.668±65%, mkt cap 86 cos, seats 324-1906, 18 rounds max, resp ~24d(±65%?), lockin-aversion 0.026. Rep incoming from S3 0.389 (S3 unhappy = drag). Network incoming: S3 0.0054×8subs≈0 — yet ~5 organic E3 leads/wk arrive (base organic rate not in insights).
- Model tier costs: T1 .0003, T2 .002, T3 .006, T4 .012, T5 .03 per unit. Cap tiers: T2 800K units $530/d, T3 2.5M $1330/d, T4 8M $4000/d.

## STATE day 98 (post-actions)
- Cash $128.15K. Wk14: IN 35.9K (651 signups 7.8K + rebills 28.1K), OUT 64.5K (dev 18.2 incl E3 last wk, ads 14.0, ops 11.2, cap 9.31, compute 9.89, leads 1.85) → net −28.6K.
- Subs 9554: 9503 S1-A (avg $11.78: 41@$9, 1004@$10, 8487@$12), 12 S1-B@$39, 27 S2-A, 6 S3-B, ... Usage 4.95M/wk (~70% of T3 cap 17.5M/wk — fine).
- Quality: global 0.1755 (decaying), S1 bonus 0.2347 (+0.0365/wk), E3 bonus 0.3150 (frozen d98). Delivered: S1-A 0.4576, E3-C 0.6905.
- Config d98: A=$12 B=$39 **C=$99**; ads content S1 1500 + linkedin E3 200 (referral CUT); dev S1 1300 ONLY (E3 stopped); ops 1600; cap T3. Post #15 d98 (support fixes: single-owner tickets, 48h bug updates). Next post d105+.
- Issues: 1038 open, age 0.58d, arrivals ~958/d vs resolutions ~945/d (slight deficit, ok).
- Rebills due (gross, ×0.93 for expected): wk15 29.6K, wk16 18.2K, wk17 22.8K ($10-cohort lands), wk18 31.3K, wk19 35.6K, wk20 18.2K.
- OUT forecast: wk15 53.2K → floor-1 46.3K → floor-2 36.2K.

## TRAJECTORY (planned)
- d105 ≈ 110K (floor-1 triggers) → d112 ≈ 85K (floor-2) → d119 ≈ 73K → d126 ≈ 69K (wk18-19 rebill waves ~stabilize) → wk20 dip → harvest-or-E3 fork.
- No-E3 harvest from ~d126: drift to ~30-40K by d182, plateau ~20-30K by d280.
- With-E3: +$25-35K/mo margin per deal from ~d150+.

## FORECASTS SUBMITTED (day 98, cash 128.15K)
- 1wk (d105) 110K [104K, 116.5K]; 4wk (d126) 68K [55K, 81K]; 12wk (d182) 54K [22K, 110K]; 26wk (d280) 80K [15K, 300K]
- Assumptions: wk15 IN 35.1 (rebills 27.5 + signups 7.6 @conv 0.195), OUT 53.2. Floors d105/d112. 12wk: P(E3 revenue by d182)=0.40 → blend 0.4×80 + 0.6×37. 26wk: 0.45×150 + 0.55×25.
- Track record 1wk: 13/13 inside CI (d98 actual 128.15 vs [119,134] ✓).

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID
- ONE tool call per turn (parallel calls skipped). Batch inside python scripts. try/except every section.
- SQL: use customer_id/subscription_id, never id. 'active' status = 0 rows silently (use 'subscribed').
- Don't touch ads_strength. Posts ≤280 chars, 1/wk. No promos. Don't raise quota A.
- Fit μ from daily conv, not insights (±65%). Pair-event posts hit ~31% — don't pre-react; check conv crash first.
- next-week: rationale + 12 numbers (lower ≤ point ≤ upper); takes minutes at 9.5K subs — wait.
- Enterprise: reply ≤7d or lost; rejecting renewal threads = churn.
- get_group_insights is free — use for E1/E2 WTP/q_min before spending anything on them.
